login.signInSubtitle: Sign in to continue to the Clix Sales System.
login.resetSuccess: Your password was reset successfully. Please sign in.
login.genericError: Unable to sign in. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.checkEmailMessage: If an account exists for that address, we've sent a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.invalidLinkMessage: This password reset link is missing its token. Request a new one below.
resetPassword.passwordPolicy: Password must be at least 8 characters and include an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
resetPassword.genericError: This reset link is invalid or has expired.

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.message: For your security, you've been signed out due to inactivity. Please sign in again to continue.
